returnsBody: At Jan Leslie, we offer returns within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Simply Press "Contact Customer Care" or email us at info@janleslie.com for a return label. Items must be in their original, sellable condition with packaging and packing slip. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method.
